```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5)

required_packages <- c(
  "readxl", "dplyr", "MASS", "emmeans", "car", "ggplot2",
  "multcomp", "multcompView", "broom", "knitr"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[!vapply(
  required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE
)]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop("Install the following packages before knitting: ",
       paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
}

invisible(lapply(required_packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

# Sum-to-zero contrasts make Type III tests appropriate for these factorial models.
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))

treatment_labels <- c(
  "SL" = "Single Litter",
  "DL" = "Double Litter",
  "NL" = "No Litter"
)

# Make compact-letter displays from the same Tukey-adjusted pairwise tests
# reported in the tables. Groups that share a letter are not significantly different.
make_tukey_letters <- function(emm_object) {
  pairwise_results <- as.data.frame(summary(pairs(emm_object, adjust = "tukey")))
  p_values <- pairwise_results$p.value
  names(p_values) <- gsub(" / ", "-", pairwise_results$contrast, fixed = TRUE)
  letter_vector <- multcompView::multcompLetters(p_values, Letters = letters)$Letters
  tibble::tibble(level = names(letter_vector), letters = unname(letter_vector))
}
```

# Overview

This document analyzes seed predation from the **Totals** sheet and invertebrate
observations from the **Surveys** sheet of `Invertebrate_seed_predation_2025.xlsx`.
The workflow uses negative-binomial generalized linear models because the response
variables are counts. Reference plots are excluded from every analysis.
Single Litter is the control treatment.

```{r import-and-clean}
excel_file <- "Invertebrate_seed_predation_2025.xlsx"
if (!file.exists(excel_file)) {
  stop("Could not find ", excel_file,
       ". Open this Rmd from the folder that contains the workbook.")
}

# The first seven columns of the Totals sheet are the raw seed-predation data;
# later columns contain spreadsheet summaries and are intentionally excluded.
predation_data <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "Totals ", .name_repair = "minimal")
predation_data <- predation_data[, 1:7]
names(predation_data) <- c(
    "plot", "treatment", "time", "date", "number_seeds_predated",
    "rain_in", "wet"
  )
predation_data <- predation_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    plot = factor(plot),
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("SL", "DL", "NL")),
    time = factor(time, levels = c("Day", "Night")),
    date = as.Date(date),
    number_seeds_predated = as.numeric(number_seeds_predated),
    rain_in = as.numeric(rain_in),
    wet = factor(wet)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(number_seeds_predated), !is.na(treatment), !is.na(time)
  )

# Retain the first 13 columns of Surveys; later columns are spreadsheet summaries.
survey_data <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "Surveys", .name_repair = "minimal")
survey_data <- survey_data[, 1:13]
names(survey_data) <- c(
    "plot", "treatment", "round", "date", "hour", "time",
    "number_predated", "slugs_present", "ants_present", "ua_present",
    "temperature_f", "humidity_pct", "wet"
  )
survey_data <- survey_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    plot = factor(plot),
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("SL", "DL", "NL")),
    round = factor(round),
    date = as.Date(date),
    time = factor(time, levels = c("E", "M", "N")),
    number_predated = as.numeric(number_predated),
    slugs_present = as.numeric(slugs_present),
    ants_present = as.numeric(ants_present),
    ua_present = as.numeric(ua_present),
    temperature_f = as.numeric(temperature_f),
    humidity_pct = as.numeric(humidity_pct),
    wet = factor(wet)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(treatment), !is.na(time))

data_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  predation_data |>
    dplyr::summarise(data_set = "Seed predation (Totals)", n = dplyr::n()),
  survey_data |>
    dplyr::summarise(data_set = "Invertebrate surveys", n = dplyr::n())
)
knitr::kable(data_summary, caption = "Rows retained for analysis")
```

# Seed predation

## Model and omnibus tests

```{r seed-predation-model}
seed_model <- MASS::glm.nb(
  number_seeds_predated ~ treatment * time,
  data = predation_data
)

seed_dispersion <- sum(residuals(seed_model, type = "pearson")^2) /
  df.residual(seed_model)

knitr::kable(
  broom::tidy(seed_model), digits = 3,
  caption = "Negative-binomial model coefficients for seed predation"
)

seed_anova <- car::Anova(seed_model, type = 3) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term")
knitr::kable(seed_anova, digits = 3,
             caption = "Type III tests for seed predation")

cat("Pearson dispersion ratio:", round(seed_dispersion, 2), "\n")
```

## Treatment differences within time of day

```{r seed-predation-emmeans}
seed_emm <- emmeans::emmeans(seed_model, ~ treatment | time, type = "response")
seed_pairwise <- pairs(seed_emm, adjust = "tukey")
seed_letters <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(levels(predation_data$time), function(time_level) {
  time_emm <- emmeans::emmeans(
    seed_model, ~ treatment, at = list(time = time_level), type = "response"
  )
  make_tukey_letters(time_emm) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      treatment = factor(level, levels = levels(predation_data$treatment)),
      time = time_level,
      letters
    )
})) |>
  dplyr::mutate(time = factor(time, levels = levels(predation_data$time)))

knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(summary(seed_emm)), digits = 3,
  caption = "Estimated mean seed predation by treatment and time"
)
knitr::kable(
  broom::tidy(seed_pairwise), digits = 3,
  caption = "Tukey-adjusted treatment comparisons within time of day"
)
```

```{r seed-predation-figure}
# One letter family compares all treatment × time combinations in this figure.
seed_all_emm <- emmeans::emmeans(seed_model, ~ treatment * time, type = "response")
seed_all_letters <- make_tukey_letters(seed_all_emm) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    treatment = factor(sub(" .*", "", level), levels = levels(predation_data$treatment)),
    time = sub("^.* ", "", level),
    letters
  )

seed_plot_data <- as.data.frame(summary(seed_all_emm)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(seed_all_letters, by = c("treatment", "time")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    se_lower = pmax(0, response - SE),
    se_upper = response + SE,
    label_y = se_upper + 0.04 * max(response)
  )

ggplot(seed_plot_data, aes(x = treatment, y = response, fill = time)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = se_lower, ymax = se_upper),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(y = label_y, label = letters, group = time),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), vjust = 0, size = 5
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = treatment_labels) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Day" = "#FFD84D", "Night" = "#001F3F")) +
  labs(
    x = "Treatment", y = "Estimated mean seeds removed",
    fill = "Time of day",
    #title = "Seed predation by treatment and time of day",
    #subtitle = "Error bars show ±1 standard error; letters compare all treatment × time groups"
  )
```

## Planned comparisons with the Single Litter control

```{r seed-predation-control-comparisons}
seed_treatment_emm <- emmeans::emmeans(seed_model, ~ treatment, type = "response")
seed_vs_single_litter <- contrast(
  seed_treatment_emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = "SL", adjust = "dunnett"
)
knitr::kable(
  broom::tidy(seed_vs_single_litter), digits = 3,
  caption = "Dunnett-adjusted comparisons with the Single Litter control, averaged across time"
)
```

## Mean seed predation by treatment

```{r seed-treatment-figure}
seed_treatment_letters <- make_tukey_letters(seed_treatment_emm) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    treatment = factor(level, levels = levels(predation_data$treatment)), letters
  )

seed_treatment_plot <- as.data.frame(summary(seed_treatment_emm)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(seed_treatment_letters, by = "treatment") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    se_lower = pmax(0, response - SE),
    se_upper = response + SE,
    label_y = se_upper + 0.04 * max(response)
  )

ggplot(seed_treatment_plot, aes(x = treatment, y = response)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#8A5406", width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = se_lower, ymax = se_upper), width = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(y = label_y, label = letters), vjust = 0, size = 5) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = treatment_labels) +
  labs(
    x = "Treatment", y = "Estimated mean number of seeds removed",
    #title = "Mean seed predation by treatment",
    #subtitle = "Means are averaged across day and night; error bars show ±1 standard error"
  )
```

# Invertebrate observations

The survey models use the recorded counts of slugs and ants. They are analyzed
separately because these organisms have different activity patterns.

## Treatment effects

```{r invertebrate-treatment-models}
slug_treatment_model <- MASS::glm.nb(slugs_present ~ treatment, data = survey_data)
ant_treatment_model <- MASS::glm.nb(ants_present ~ treatment, data = survey_data)

slug_treatment_anova <- car::Anova(slug_treatment_model, type = 3) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term")
ant_treatment_anova <- car::Anova(ant_treatment_model, type = 3) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term")

knitr::kable(slug_treatment_anova, digits = 3,
             caption = "Type III test: slug counts by treatment")
knitr::kable(ant_treatment_anova, digits = 3,
             caption = "Type III test: ant counts by treatment")
```

```{r invertebrate-treatment-figure}
slug_treatment_emm <- emmeans::emmeans(
  slug_treatment_model, ~ treatment, type = "response"
)
ant_treatment_emm <- emmeans::emmeans(
  ant_treatment_model, ~ treatment, type = "response"
)
slug_treatment_letters <- make_tukey_letters(slug_treatment_emm) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    treatment = factor(level, levels = levels(survey_data$treatment)), letters
  )
ant_treatment_letters <- make_tukey_letters(ant_treatment_emm) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    treatment = factor(level, levels = levels(survey_data$treatment)), letters
  )

invertebrate_treatment_plot <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  as.data.frame(summary(slug_treatment_emm)) |>
    dplyr::left_join(slug_treatment_letters, by = "treatment") |>
    dplyr::mutate(species = "Slug"),
  as.data.frame(summary(ant_treatment_emm)) |>
    dplyr::left_join(ant_treatment_letters, by = "treatment") |>
    dplyr::mutate(species = "Ant")
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    se_lower = pmax(0, response - SE),
    se_upper = response + SE,
    label_y = se_upper + 0.04 * max(response)
  )

ggplot(invertebrate_treatment_plot,
       aes(x = treatment, y = response, fill = species)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = se_lower, ymax = se_upper),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(y = label_y, label = letters, group = species),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), vjust = 0, size = 5
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = treatment_labels) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Slug" = "sienna3", "Ant" = "slateblue4")) +
  labs(
    x = "Treatment", y = "Estimated mean count", fill = "Organism",
    #title = "Slug and ant observations by treatment",
    #subtitle = "Error bars show ±1 standard error; letters compare treatments within each organism"
  )
```

## Treatment-by-time models

```{r invertebrate-time-models}
# The final figure compares the early (E) and late (N) surveys only.
survey_data_en <- survey_data |>
  dplyr::filter(time %in% c("E", "N")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(time = factor(time, levels = c("E", "N")))

slug_time_model <- MASS::glm.nb(slugs_present ~ treatment * time, data = survey_data_en)
ant_time_model <- MASS::glm.nb(ants_present ~ treatment * time, data = survey_data_en)

slug_time_anova <- car::Anova(slug_time_model, type = 3) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term")
ant_time_anova <- car::Anova(ant_time_model, type = 3) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term")

knitr::kable(slug_time_anova, digits = 3,
             caption = "Type III tests: slug counts by treatment and time")
knitr::kable(ant_time_anova, digits = 3,
             caption = "Type III tests: ant counts by treatment and time")
```

## Seed predation between morning and evening surveys

```{r survey-seed-predation-figure}
survey_predation_data <- survey_data_en |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(number_predated))

survey_predation_model <- MASS::glm.nb(
  number_predated ~ treatment * time,
  data = survey_predation_data
)
survey_predation_anova <- car::Anova(survey_predation_model, type = 3) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term")
knitr::kable(
  survey_predation_anova, digits = 3,
  caption = "Type III tests: seed predation between surveys"
)

survey_predation_emm <- emmeans::emmeans(
  survey_predation_model, ~ treatment * time, type = "response"
)
survey_predation_letters <- make_tukey_letters(survey_predation_emm) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    treatment = factor(sub(" .*", "", level), levels = levels(survey_data$treatment)),
    time = sub("^.* ", "", level),
    letters
  )

survey_predation_plot <- as.data.frame(summary(survey_predation_emm)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(survey_predation_letters, by = c("treatment", "time")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    treatment_time = factor(
      paste(treatment, time, sep = "_"),
      levels = c("SL_E", "SL_N", "DL_E", "DL_N", "NL_E", "NL_N")
    ),
    se_lower = pmax(0, response - SE),
    se_upper = response + SE,
    label_y = se_upper + 0.04 * max(response)
  )

# Grouped treatment figure: morning and evening bars are shown together by treatment.
ggplot(survey_predation_plot, aes(x = treatment, y = response, fill = time)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = se_lower, ymax = se_upper),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(y = label_y, label = letters, group = time),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), vjust = 0, size = 5
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = treatment_labels) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("E" = "#FFD84D", "N" = "#001F3F"),
    labels = c("E" = "Morning", "N" = "Evening")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Treatment", y = "Estimated mean seeds removed",
    fill = "Survey time",
   # title = "Seed predation by treatment between morning and evening surveys",
   #subtitle = "Error bars show ±1 standard error; letters compare all treatment × time groups"
  )
 
)

```

```{r invertebrate-time-figure}
# Each set of letters compares all six treatment × time groups within one organism.
slug_time_emm <- emmeans::emmeans(slug_time_model, ~ treatment * time, type = "response")
ant_time_emm <- emmeans::emmeans(ant_time_model, ~ treatment * time, type = "response")
slug_time_letters <- make_tukey_letters(slug_time_emm) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    treatment = factor(sub(" .*", "", level), levels = levels(survey_data$treatment)),
    time = sub("^.* ", "", level),
    letters
  )
ant_time_letters <- make_tukey_letters(ant_time_emm) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    treatment = factor(sub(" .*", "", level), levels = levels(survey_data$treatment)),
    time = sub("^.* ", "", level),
    letters
  )

invertebrate_time_plot <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  as.data.frame(summary(slug_time_emm)) |>
    dplyr::left_join(slug_time_letters, by = c("treatment", "time")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(species = "Slug"),
  as.data.frame(summary(ant_time_emm)) |>
    dplyr::left_join(ant_time_letters, by = c("treatment", "time")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(species = "Ant")
) |>
  dplyr::group_by(treatment, species) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    se_lower = pmax(0, response - SE),
    se_upper = response + SE,
    label_y = se_upper + 0.04 * max(response)
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

ggplot(invertebrate_time_plot, aes(x = time, y = response, fill = species)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = se_lower, ymax = se_upper),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(y = label_y, label = letters, group = species),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), vjust = 0, size = 4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ treatment, labeller = labeller(treatment = treatment_labels)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Slug" = "sienna3", "Ant" = "slateblue4")) +
  labs(
    x = "Survey time", y = "Estimated mean count", fill = "Organism",
    #title = "Slug and ant observations during early and late surveys",
    #subtitle = "Error bars show ±1 standard error; letters compare all treatment × time groups within each organism"
  )
```
